verdicts.quote: When a seat in a class becomes free and that class's waitlist has entries, the first entry whose member can book the class is booked into the seat
Waitlist order is the order in which joins were confirmed, earliest first, and no two entries share a position ... two joins that arrive at the same instant still get two different positions.
verdicts.missing: How a same-instant tie is broken (which joiner gets the earlier position), and whether any membership tier jumps the queue; only staff placement (C-48) is addressed.

verdicts.quote: A joins waitlists for two overlapping classes, is promoted into the first; at their turn for the second, if the app forbids overlapping bookings, they are passed over under C-13 with the overlap reason.
subject to the same cancellation rules (including any late-cancellation rule) as a direct booking. The app does not add exemptions or penalties because it came from the waitlist.
The events that free a seat, and so start a promotion under C-8, are exactly these five ... the first member able to book holds the seat (within the time in C-39).
Messages about the waitlist are delivered by the same channel (or channels) the app uses today for booking confirmations, and are also visible inside the app
When two or more seats become free at the same time, each goes to a different waitlisted member in waitlist order, and no waitlisted member is booked twice
A member is never both booked in a class and on that class's waitlist
verdicts.missing: What the waitlisted member themselves sees and which request wins when they attempt a direct booking at the moment they are promoted; C-9 covers only a different member, C-116 only a leave.

verdicts.quote: If the charge fails, there is no booking, the member is passed over under C-13 with the reason that payment could not be taken, and no credit has been taken
Joining is refused if the waitlist already holds the maximum number of entries ... The member is told the waitlist for the class is full; no entry is created
Booking close for the waitlist is the same moment after which the app today refuses direct bookings of that class; where the app has no such moment, it is the class's start time
When staff raise capacity by n seats, up to n waitlisted members are booked, in waitlist order
When a class is cancelled, its whole waitlist is removed ... Within 5 minutes (C-92) no waitlist entries remain for the cancelled class
each with position, member name, the date and time the join was confirmed, and either "can book" or the reason from C-12
verdicts.missing: The entry's stored state values, and whether position is stored or derived from join order.

verdicts.quote: When booking closes with entries still on the waitlist, every remaining entry is removed
A member sees only their own position and entries, never who else is on a waitlist and never the length of the waitlist beyond being told whether it is full
The staff view of a class's waitlist lists every entry in position order
verdicts.missing: Whether staff can promote a waitlisted member into a seat by hand; only add, remove and viewing the log are stated.

verdicts.quote: The operator can switch the waitlist Off for one class occurrence, and On again
A promotion is complete, meaning the booking exists and is visible in the member's bookings, within 60 seconds of the seat becoming free
Direct booking of a class that is not full behaves exactly as before, with the waitlist On or Off: same rules, same price, same confirmation
Classes that are already full when the feature is released or turned on start with an empty waitlist; nobody is added automatically, and no existing booking changes
